definitions.explanation: Refers to each individual item or person within a group, emphasizing them as separate entities rather than as a collective.

examples.japanese: {個々|ここ}の{事情|じじょう}を{考慮|こうりょ}する。
examples.english: To take individual circumstances into consideration.

examples.japanese: {個々|ここ}の{能力|のうりょく}に{合|あ}わせた{指導|しどう}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Instruction tailored to individual abilities is necessary.

examples.japanese: {問題|もんだい}を{個々|ここ}に{検討|けんとう}するのではなく、{全体|ぜんたい}として{捉|とら}える{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: Rather than examining each issue individually, we need to grasp them as a whole.

notes:
Typically used with the particle の to modify nouns: {個々|ここ}の{問題|もんだい} (each individual problem). Can also be used adverbially with に: {個々|ここ}に{対応|たいおう}する (to deal with each one individually).

A homophone of ここ (here), but written in kanji so there is no ambiguity in text.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {個々|ここ}の{事例|じれい} — individual cases
- {個々|ここ}の{対応|たいおう} — individual handling
- {個々|ここ}に — individually; separately
- {個々|ここ}の{違|ちが}い — individual differences
